similarityReview: The 3D model accurately reconstructs the multi-tiered octagonal pagoda. It features a solid base, multiple stacked octagonal prism body segments, and outward-flaring frustum pyramid eaves at each level. Arched windows are placed symmetrically on the facades, and the structure is topped with a characteristic multi-stage spire. All parts are tightly integrated with no gaps, and the back is fully mirrored to ensure 360-degree completeness.
